title: Ngọn hải đăng xa
about: Round x10, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked to go on ("ok chúng ta hãy tiếp tục sáng tác nhạc"), on the sounds the user liked most: a lighthouse far across the night sea: the swells, a soft pad, a single low string improvising a slow song. D minor. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
